stem.text: A crate of mass $50\,\text{kg}$ is pushed a distance of $6.0\,\text{m}$ along a horizontal surface against a constant resistive force of $70\,\text{N}$. The crate moves at a constant speed. It is then lifted, at a constant speed, through a vertical distance of $1.2\,\text{m}$ onto the back of a lorry.
What is the total work done in this process?
